download_metadata: download the National Gallery of Art published images metadata CSV file from the NGA open data GitHub repository
download_item: download a single image from the NGA IIIF API by UUID and save it to the output folder
remove_non_compliant_image: check and remove images that exceed their max pixel size constraints from the processed folder
reshape_image: resize an image to match its expected width and height dimensions from the filename size map
run_download_preprocess_nga: run the NGA image download and preprocessing pipeline with multiprocessing to fetch, validate, and reshape images
